name: ai-security-sdlc
description: Agent plugins for securing an AI-first SDLC: secure-by-design planning, AI evals, red teaming, pentest, SAST and remediation.

plugins.name: ai-security-ai-evals
plugins.description: Test phase: Promptfoo baseline quality evals with an AI-metrics pack, plus curated cybersecurity benchmark suites (b3, CyberSecEval 4, HarmBench, XSTest, JBB) run against your LLM app.

plugins.name: ai-security-ai-redteam
plugins.description: Test phase: Promptfoo multi-turn adversarial red teaming of your LLM app, configured from its security profile (OWASP LLM/Agentic, PII, injection, tool abuse).

plugins.name: ai-security-asset-scan
plugins.description: Scan a packaged AI asset — an open-weights model, an MCP server, or an agent skill — that you are building or about to download and trust. Wraps Hugging Face's published weight scans + Promptfoo ModelAudit, Cisco mcp-scanner, and Cisco skill-scanner; results as SARIF for the remediation flow.

plugins.name: ai-security-code-scan
plugins.description: Test phase: scan the code you write for security issues — an open-ended, model-driven code review (SARIF + report), CodeQL CI setup, and reading CodeQL results back. Tool-agnostic.

plugins.name: ai-security-pentest
plugins.description: Test phase: autonomous DAST penetration testing of your app with Strix, scoped from the security profile, with SARIF results.

plugins.name: ai-security-remediate
plugins.description: Remediation phase: ingest every finding in .ai-security/results (SARIF + promptfoo JSON), triage, fix, add regressions and close the loop into planning rules.

plugins.name: ai-security-secure-plan
plugins.description: Plan/Code phase: app security profile and CodeGuard-backed Compliant Build Plans so features are specified secure-by-design before code is written.
